description: Image Description: The image depicts a muddy surface, likely a tidal flat or beach area during low tide. On the left side of the image, there is an object that appears to be a small, overturned wooden chair partially submerged in the mud. The chair's legs are sticking out, and its seat is buried. On the right side of the image, a seagull is standing on the mud, casting a shadow. The bird is facing to the right and is positioned towards the bottom right corner
